scope: One physical follow session with Vosk voice commands after switching the NAO profile to the box-width proximity proxy and to slow advance while turning. Software decisions are logged; physical distance, braking and recognition accuracy were not measured.

configuration.forward_scale_when_off_center: 1 through +/-24 px, linear to 1/3 at +/-60 px, 1/3 beyond

source.note: Local logs, not versioned. No images, audio or transcript text are stored.

single_person_frames.method: Distinct perception snapshots in events.jsonl with exactly one eligible person; clipping counted within 1 px of the top/bottom border.

author_observation.statement: The author reported that the session worked perfectly.

software_checks_before_the_session.suites: test_follow_controller; test_follow_motion, test_follow_session, test_follow_camera, test_voice_commands, test_camera_geometry, test_follow_launch, test_integrated_hri, test_follow_mode, test_follow_speech, test_hri_diagnostics

offline_replay.note: Each box evaluated alone after three identical observations; not a physical test.

limits: Single session; no controlled comparison against the height proxy on the same day and scene.
The distance at which the robot holds was not measured; 0.33 is a fraction of image width, not meters.
Voice recovery after an audio stream timeout is unchanged and was not exercised (speech stayed available).
hri_app returned exit code 1 on Ctrl+C; worker processes finished cleanly.
Changes are local and uncommitted on branch perf/whisper-follow-cpu when this file was written.
